prior_coverage:
Nobody has swept these as single-account venues before. The repo's only print-on-demand verdicts are these. docs/REJECTED.md:274 rejects multi-shop Etsy/POD as RED, because operating it means defeating account-linking detection, and says: 'A single shop is a different question and is not rejected here'. docs/REJECTED.md:275 rejects Amazon Merch on Demand: a tier ladder that advances only by sales, Israel on no eligible list, and a human-reviewed application. The same two rows appear in research/colony-sweep/groups/store-promotion.md:264-265 and research/colony-sweep/scouts/store-promotion--promotion-at-scale.md:113-128 and :237-238. research/colony-sweep/scouts/licensing-ip--3d-print-on-demand.md:134-139 closed physical POD merch without reopening it. For Etsy KYC, see research/colony-sweep/scouts/risk-governance--owner-kyc-catalogue.md:130-136 and research/colony-sweep/scouts/storefronts--etsy-digital.md:33, :45-46 and :73. For the AI-output ownership limit, see research/colony-sweep/scouts/licensing-ip--ai-output-rights.md:50-56 and :88. A grep of the repo for Redbubble, TeePublic, Spreadshirt, Society6, Zazzle, Displate, Threadless and Teespring finds nothing else, and research/rendered/ holds no POD page.

NEW today:
(1) github: nobody on GitHub uses an official Redbubble upload API. More than 15 uploader repos drive a browser: jalbrekt85/Redbubble-Bot says 'Uses the Chrome webdriver'. marschalk/fastShirt, an uploader for Spreadshirt, Shirtee and Redbubble, depends on puppeteer. KillianDoubre/redbubble-automation depends on puppeteer-extra-plugin-stealth, which exists to evade bot detection.
(2) github: Spreadshirt has a keyed API v1 at api.spreadshirt.net/api/v1 (mrkamel/spreadshirt_client README). No client and no code search result shows a design-upload call. Zazzle's only GitHub API wrappers are for orders and product feeds (2011-2018).
(3) snippets: Spreadshirt's own blog permits AI designs when the AI provider's terms allow commercial use, and caps uploads at 200 designs a day. Zazzle requires AI work to be tagged #generativecontent. Redbubble's help pages describe a platform fee on monthly earnings of 50% (Standard), 20% (Premium) or 0% (Pro), never charged out of pocket. TeePublic pays by PayPal with no minimum.

ANSWER: no venue in this family shows a sanctioned programmatic listing path at any grade. Every venue's AI, fee and payout evidence is snippet grade at best. Every venue costs one new owner account, and most also need a PayPal Israel account, which today is only a conditional step (docs/OWNER_STEPS.he.md:385). Spreadshirt is the only venue worth a render batch, because it has the only API trace and a first-party AI permission.

Dropped:
- Spring (Teespring): its sales come from the creator's own audience, not marketplace discovery. Grade none; no search spent.
- Amazon Merch: REJECTED.md:275 stands; there is no new evidence.
- Printful or Printify into our own store: outside this family. It brings no buyers, and the seller pays the fulfilment cost before any payout, which breaks ₪0 (grade none).

If every surviving venue worked, the family's ceiling is about ₪1,500-2,000/month at month 12, for about six new owner steps.

candidates.venue: Spreadshirt (Marketplace Designer + a free Spreadshop from the same partner account)
candidates.what_we_would_list: A deliberately capped stream, at most ~10 designs a week, far below the 200/day platform cap, never near-duplicates. (1) Code-generated bilingual Hebrew/English typographic designs: wordplay, idioms with translations, city names set in Hebrew letterforms. (2) Algorithmic/geometric art rendered from code. (3) Data-viz posters and prints from CC0 or self-computed data. Each design is published once and the platform puts it on its product range. AI assistance is declared in each description, and every design is checked against the AI provider's commercial-use terms, which is Spreadshirt's own condition.
candidates.existing_product: None. The nearest reusable code is products/chart-explainer (data-to-chart renderer, Python), for data posters. No design pipeline, print-resolution export or design QA exists yet.
candidates.listings_per_owner_step: One partner account opens both the Marketplace and a free branded Spreadshop (spreadshop under 'mehudak'). Up to 200 designs a day is the platform cap (spreadshirt.com blog 2017-10-09, raised 2020-05-06; snippet). Each design becomes many products. Whether EU (spreadshirt.net/.de) and NA (spreadshirt.com) need two partner accounts is UNKNOWN; Marki396/upload-automata treats 'Spreadshirt DE und COM' as separate targets (github description only).

Not read at primary grade: the partner T&Cs.

gate_programmatic_listing.evidence: A keyed public API v1 exists: mrkamel/spreadshirt_client README sets api_key, api_secret and base_url https://api.spreadshirt.net/api/v1, but its examples cover only baskets and orders. ubirkemeyer/spreadshirtapps holds v1 samples from 2011-2013. GitHub code search for design-upload calls against api/v1 found nothing. The one current multi-venue uploader (marschalk/fastShirt) depends on puppeteer, which suggests that uploads are done through the portal. developer.spreadshirt.net and api.spreadshirt.net are EGRESS_BLOCKED here. Leaning FAIL unless the developer docs show a design-upload endpoint that partners may use.

gate_ai_allowed_honest.evidence: Spreadshirt's own blog, 'AI and designs: dos & don'ts' (2024-06-07), per the snippet: if the AI provider's terms permit unrestricted commercial use, AI-made designs may be uploaded and published on the Marketplace and in a Spreadshop. There is no disclosure field, so the declaration goes in each description. Ownership limit: sell as a non-exclusive licence only (licensing-ip--ai-output-rights.md:88).

gate_buyer_supply.evidence: A consumer marketplace exists where designers earn on sales they did not bring: the help article 'Earn money as a Marketplace Designer' and the fixed marketplace commission (snippets). No traffic, GMV or conversion numbers were found.

candidates.discovery_needs_prior_sale: UNKNOWN. How marketplace search ranks a new design with no sales was not found. The Spreadshop brings no buyers of its own.
candidates.owner_step: NEW step. Open a Spreadshirt partner account under the brand username; the legal name is for payout and tax only. Complete the tax and payout details, and link a PayPal Israel account, a new or conditional step (docs/OWNER_STEPS.he.md:385), if PayPal is the rail. Hand over an API key and secret, if the API allows uploads. Possibly two accounts (EU and NA). candidates.estimate_basis: INFERENCE, not a base rate. The margin is about $3 per standard tee (snippet). The low case is a cold account that never surfaces in search. Net of PayPal's ₪8 withdrawal fee below ₪1,000 and a ~3-4% conversion markup (paypal-israel.md:24-28 and F2, snippet).
candidates.time_to_first_sale: UNKNOWN. The floor is the owner step, then the first batch, then a sale, then the monthly payout at a $10 minimum: about 6-10 weeks after the owner acts. It may never come on a cold account.
